title: Finiteness of homological dimensions of RHom complexes
summary: This paper studies derived Hom complexes with finite projective, Gorenstein projective, or complete intersection dimension over a Noetherian local ring $R$. We establish several stability results concerning finite complete intersection homological dimension of derived Hom complexes. In addition, for $R$-complexes $M$ and $N$ we study when $\operatorname{\textbf{R}Hom}_R(M,N)$ has finite projective, complete intersection dimension or Gorenstein projective dimension under either of the assumptions that $\operatorname{Gpd}_R(N)<\infty$ or $\operatorname{Gid}_R(M)<\infty$.
